name: Light Wipe
description: A band of intense light sweeps across the frame like a glint on glass, blooming the highlights of both clips, and leaves the second clip behind it. Drive `progress` from 0 to 1.

inputs.name: second
inputs.description: Incoming clip (same size as the first)

params.name: direction
params.description: Direction the band of light moves toward (x right, y up)

params.name: width
params.description: Width of the bright core of the band, in frame heights

params.name: color
params.description: Tint of the light toward the edges of the band (its core burns white)
